text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, this picture is perfect! ☆ I bet it
gets a
tooon of likes! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah! ☆ I'm super photogenic
recently!
choice_data_list: In a good mood, are we?
In a good mood, are we?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Like, check out my smile in this pic I
took at the
end of training! It's the
cutest thing ever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Buuut... I don't really get why.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I always used to be so out of breath
after races
and training... I wonder what
changed?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Now that you mention it, that's
probably it!
choice_data_list: Did your stamina increase or something?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to you and your superstar
training!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
choice_data_list: If so, that'd make me really happy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I know! I'm gonna throw a surprise
event as a
thank you!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Get ready for Heartthrob ☆ Umadol
Falco's
extra-special photo op!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Duh! If I really want to express my
thanks
properly...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What better way than to show off this
cuteness
that we've perfected
together! ♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Now's the perfect chance to get a good
shot!
Don't hold back! Take as many as
you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems my daily instruction has helped
Smart
Falcon improve both her physical
strength and
her Umadol power!
